business_problem: Foxtel Group needed to improve customer sentiment, first-contact resolution, and cost to serve as streaming competition intensified, but managing millions of interactions across channels required smarter automation and a more connected operating model than its existing support setup could provide.
solution_summary: Foxtel Group and TCS created a next-generation contact-center operating model that combines AI, GenAI, analytics, and augmented reality. TCS introduced a business-as-a-service orchestration layer that aligns IT and operations, then fed sales, support, marketing, and product signals into a connected-intelligence model for end-to-end visibility. Within that flow, GenAI Agent Assist captures customer context, reads Foxtel's knowledge base, analyzes interaction history, suggests real-time responses, and auto-summarizes conversations for agents. Advanced monitoring and analytics track satisfaction, resolution, and system performance, while IVR, chatbots, and AR-based remote assist handle or accelerate customer interactions before they become costly field visits. The result is an AI-led service architecture designed to blend self-service, agent assist, and observability inside one continuously improving CX engine.
